title: Is the Rally Real? 5 Stocks to Buy Now Before Election Day
creator: MarketBeat
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; captions readable
summary: MarketBeat host with analyst Thomas Hughes's October buy list ahead of election day and Q3 earnings season. Hughes expects the election to ease market headwinds and Q4 to be seasonally strong, and notes September repositioning punished stocks not monetizing AI. Five BUY calls. AMD: bullish-flag breakout; MI450/Helios rack launch unlocking explosive GPU sales growth with big backstop orders from OpenAI and Oracle; base case $370 target, bull case ~200% upside to $1,200-$1,300 by year-end; bear case is execution risk on the launch (no supply-chain red flags seen). CRDO (Credo Technologies): AI-critical connectivity (AEC copper cables with data-integrity and cost benefits over fiber); surging backlog, expects hot revenue growth and guidance; photonics as the future; base case retests/sets new highs; bear case: failing to set a new high would signal the outlook topping out. BE (Bloom Energy): fuel-cell power shipping today for data centers; all hyperscalers and neoclouds validated the technology; first-mover advantage vs nuclear years away; up ~275% in a year with volatility; bear case: big blue-chip industrials could eventually compete. TGT (Target): first time on his list — rebound from managerial missteps, regaining share, resilient spending, strong holiday season expected to outperform retail peers; bear case: trades near consensus target, retail discretionary headwinds. LPTH (LightPath Technologies): optics/photonics pivoting to defense-aerospace, divesting China assets, germanium-free proprietary glass aiding supply-chain security; speculative — revenue-generating but not yet profitable; >20% short interest is a squeeze opportunity on strong earnings.
